```{r cars}
require(DBI) #loads odbc as well

```


```{r}
library(stacks)
all.models <- readRDS("./models/final_species_models.rds")
coast.bgc <- c("CWH", "CDF")

new_dat <- sibec.anal# |> filter(Zone %in% coast.bgc)

pred_dat <- new_dat %>%
  mutate(SI50_4C_pred = NA_real_)

for (species in names(all.models$stack)) {

  # Rows belonging to this species
  idx <- pred_dat$TreeSpp == species & !is.na(pred_dat$TreeSpp)

  # Only predict if there are matching records
  if (any(idx)) {

    pred_dat$SI50_4C_pred[idx] <- predict(
      all.models$stack[[species]],
      new_data = pred_dat[idx, ]
    )$.pred

  }
}
preds <- pred_dat |> select(PlotNumber, TreeSpp, SI50_4C_pred)
sibec.anal <- readRDS("./data/SIBEC_Analysis_data_2026.rds") |> filter(SI50 >0.5) |> left_join(preds)
sibec.anal2 <- sibec.anal |> select(Zone,BGC, PlotNumber, TreeSpp, aSMR, rSMR, rSNR, SI50, SI50_4C_pred) |> mutate(SI50_diff = round(SI50 - SI50_4C_pred,2)) |> distinct()
```

Predict 4C edatope SI50 for all records including those with azonal
review for oddities in 4C predictions 
```{r}
test.sibec <- sibec.anal2 |>
  filter(rSMR == 4, rSNR == "C") |>
  group_by(TreeSpp) |>
  mutate(
    n = sum(!is.na(SI50_diff)),
    TreeSpp_n = (paste0(TreeSpp, "\n", n))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(
  test.sibec,
  aes(
    x = reorder(TreeSpp_n, SI50_diff, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = SI50_diff
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tree species",
    y = "SI50 difference"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```


Summarize by BGC, TreeSpp, rSMR, rSNR

```{r}
sibec.anal2 <- sibec.anal |> select(Zone,BGC, PlotNumber, TreeSpp, aSMR, rSMR, SNR = rSNR, SI50, SI50_4C_pred) |> mutate(SI50_diff = round(SI50 - SI50_4C_pred,2)) |> distinct()

sibec.summary <- sibec.anal2 |>
  group_by(BGC, TreeSpp, rSMR, SNR) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(
      c(SI50, SI50_4C_pred, SI50_diff),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        min  = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max  = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(BGC, TreeSpp, rSMR, SNR)

xx <- sibec.summary |> filter(n>2, TreeSpp == "Pl")
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Cell-level counts
edatopic.sum <- sibec.anal2 %>% filter(SI50 >0.5) |> 
  count(
    BGC,
    TreeSpp,
    rSMR,
    SNR,
    name = "n"
  )

bgc_coverage <- edatopic.sum %>%
  group_by(TreeSpp, BGC) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),              # occupied edatopic cells
    n_records = sum(n),         # total observations
    mean_per_cell = mean(n),
    min_per_cell = min(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

best_bgc <- bgc_coverage %>%
  group_by(TreeSpp) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_cells),
    desc(n_records)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

best_bgc

edatopic.sum %>%
  filter(
    TreeSpp == "Sx",
    BGC == "SBSmc2"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = SNR,
      y = factor(
        rSMR,
        levels = 8:0
      ),
      fill = n
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    x = "rSNR",
    y = "rSMR",
    fill = "n"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```
